newsitem.title: UK: BTR up ahead of annual results.
newsitem.headline: BTR up ahead of annual results.

text.p: Shares in BTR Plc jumped 9-1/2p, or almost four percent, to 252 by 1105 GMT on Tuesday ahead of the group's annual results on Thursday.
Almost 3.5 million shares changed hands, making it among the most actively traded stocks in London.
Dealers said the shares, which nearly recouped last month's losses, had recovered amid hopes for a strong profit statement from the Anglo-Australian industrial conglomerate on Thursday.
The median profit forecast of analysts surveyed by Reuters was 1.03 million stg.
Separately, BTR announced that its unit Brook Hansen had formed an electrical drives alliance with Danfoss Drives Division, a unit of Denmark's Danfoss Group nFLLF345H5.
Yet dealers linked the stock advance to the results rather than the alliance, adding that no details about the linkup were provided.
